entries.name: VERKADA_API_KEY
entries.description: A read-only Verkada API key from the organization's admin, for reading occupancy trends. It is traded for a 30-minute token and goes only to Verkada.
howToGet: An organization admin opens the Verkada API tab under Organization Settings in Command, chooses + New API Key, picks Read-only permissions and an expiration, and generates the key, as Verkada's quick start guide describes. Permissions can't be changed later, so choose Read-only when making it.
The key is shown once. Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: VERKADA_REGION
entries.description: Where the organization's Verkada data lives: us (the default) or eu.
howToGet: Leave it unset for the US address, api.verkada.com. Set it to eu for an organization on api.eu.verkada.com, as Verkada's quick start guide lists.
